note: REAL SADKO campaign artwork, downloaded from the company's own live homepage (https://sadko-group.com/) on 2026-09-05 and stored under assets/img/highlights/. The banner text is baked into the images in Arabic; `title`/`sub` transcribe what each image says so screen readers and the English side have an equivalent. Do not add a 'was' price, discount %, rating or stock claim here: the catalogue carries no discount data, and these banners make none.
placement: hero = the rotating banner at the top of shop.html; slot = the ad blocks interleaved between the shop's sections. Slots are dealt out in the order below: the first goes in the wide single-banner block, the rest fill the square ad row, so a wide banner should come first.
art: The SHAPE of the artwork, and the only thing that decides whether a promo may fill the wide banner frame: 'wide' = 1600x608, 'square' = 900x900. The frame is 1600/608 and object-fit:cover, so a square tile put in it loses two thirds of its own printed Arabic message, which is how the 285x155 hotline strip lost its phone number. Measure the file; do not guess.
cats: OPTIONAL category targeting, as an array of categoryId strings. A promo carrying `cats` is shown at the top of those categories' pages and nowhere else; a promo with NO `cats` is brand-wide (instalments, delivery, best sellers) and is honest on any page, so it fills the top of a category that has no campaign of its own. Where `cats` is absent the category is still inferred from the promo's own href (`shop.html?cat=NNN` names one directly, and `product.html?id=NNN` resolves through the catalogue to that product's category), so a promo for one product already advertises itself in the right aisle. TO GIVE A CATEGORY ITS OWN BANNER: add 1600x608 artwork under assets/img/highlights/, list it here with "art":"wide" and "cats":["<categoryId>"]. Category ids are the file names in site/category/.
notIncluded: assets/img/highlights/tile-hotline.jpg (the 19140 strip) was downloaded but is not listed: it is 285x155, so the square ad tile cropped the number to '9140'. The hotline already appears in the header and the footer. Kept in the folder in case a square version is produced.
